title: Find depots by auth values
description: Payload schema for finding the depots of an internal verifiable_presentation issuer service by their auth values. Only depots created under the service's current auth rules match

authValues.description: The auth values to look up. Each item holds one depot's auth values, as depots/create takes them: one value per auth rule, in valueIndex order. They match as authentication matches them: strings trimmed and lower-cased, numbers and booleans unchanged
